relations: Curled charred paper in the upper drum actively burns, producing continuously flickering orange-yellow flames rising toward the top.
Intact white paper tubes in the lower drum remain visually fixed and unburned beneath the active fire.
The appliance body, open door, and right-side hardware remain stationary, framing the burning drum opening.
Flames and glowing edges stay confined to the upper region, flickering in shape and height without spreading downward.
caption: The video captures a largely fixed close-up view into the open circular opening of a white front-loading appliance, its door swung to the left. The lower half of the drum is packed with empty white paper tubes in a honeycomb of circular cross-sections, while the upper half holds curled, partly charred paper pieces that are actively burning. Bright orange-yellow flames rise continuously from these pieces toward the top of the drum, their shape, height and brightest tongues flickering from frame to frame. The overall fire stays confined to the upper region, and the glowing edges of the charred paper remain in roughly the same positions. The lower paper tubes are not burning, intact and visually fixed in place throughout. A barcode sticker sits at the top edge, and two screws and a small black rectangular part are fixed on the right side of the opening. The appliance body and open door remain visually stationary, with little or no camera movement evident.
